candidate: bounded per-frame Txyz with out-of-range fallback Official
limitations: Readiness uses 24 consumed subjects and 72 frames, not a new system sealed set.
Evaluation uses 5000 deterministic Camera-B points per frame rather than the previous 25000-point final metric budget.
CPU correction excludes depth preprocessing and is about 110 ms, so it is cheaper than a second SAM forward but not yet a few-millisecond kernel.
Dataset-provided ROI and registered person depth are assumed.
Whole-body surface evidence does not establish posterior torso, acupuncture, treatment-table, or raw-RGB robustness.
recommendation: Permit one frozen SYSTEM_C evaluation on a future untouched system sealed set; do not alter the bound or fallback after opening it.
